title: Reversed notes: DAW reverse setting or a reversed copy in the set folder, per M0
description:
## Intent

Reversed notes play backwards.

## Steps

- Per the M0 decision in `design/daw-set.md`:
  - DAW reverse setting: set it on the clip and mirror its warp markers.
  - Pre-rendered: `apricity-cli` (not the crate, which does no audio I/O) writes a reversed copy of each distinct reversed region into the set folder (`Samples/Processed/Reverse/`, decoded with `apricity-engine`'s `decode` feature, written with `hound`), cached by (sample, region); `apricity-daw` receives it as a file to place and mirrors the warp map.
- With `--no-collect`, reversed files still go into the set folder, so every file the set refers to exists.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` and `cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli` — "Reversed notes" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): reversed notes in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
